_comment: DOOM_Ants has no version-bearing SOURCE file, but per docs/standards/releases.md the version lives in three places in lockstep: the git tag (v<X.Y.Z>), the CHANGELOG heading, and README.md's 'Latest release' line. All three are moved by packaging/release.sh -- the single release entrypoint -- which runs the tests, builds the Linux AppImage + Windows zip, promotes the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section, rewrites the README line, tags, pushes, and publishes the GitHub release with both artifacts attached. files[] is empty because release.sh owns every edit; do not add README here or it gets bumped twice. Prefer release.sh over the generic /release skill's own build/commit/tag steps. For a single-OS rebuild, packaging/linux-build.sh or packaging/windows-build.sh build one artifact each.
post_check: test -x packaging/release.sh && CL=$(grep -m1 -oE '^## \[[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\]' CHANGELOG.md | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+') && RM=$(grep -m1 -oE 'Latest release: \*\*[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' README.md | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+') && [ "$CL" = "$RM" ] && echo "OK: CHANGELOG $CL == README $RM; release.sh keeps tag/CHANGELOG/README in lockstep"
todos: Make sure CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] holds the {NEW} changes — release.sh promotes it to `## [{NEW}] - {TODAY}` automatically on --publish.
